prompts: Production sprite sheet for the pixel art beat-em-up Distrito Quimera. Reference shows the EXACT visual style, squat 2.8-head proportions and boots of three existing characters. Draw 16 independent whole-body sprites on genuinely transparent background in a regular FOUR COLUMNS by FOUR ROWS grid, identical ground baseline per row, all facing RIGHT. Row 1 all four poses are a NEW fast street bruiser wearing a purple knit cap, burgundy sleeveless work jacket over black shirt, grey work trousers, tan gloves and boots, wielding a wooden baseball bat. Row 2 all four poses are a NEW bulkier dock foreman with yellow hardhat, dark beard, teal mechanic coveralls rolled to the elbows and tan boots holding a silver aluminum baseball bat. Row 3 all four poses are CAP DOLLAR, exactly the FIRST reference character with spiky brown hair, RED headband tails, olive shirt, green trousers, brown boots and wrist wraps, holding the wooden baseball bat. For each of rows 1, 2 and 3 the four poses left to right must be: 1. neutral balanced split stance with bat upright over rear shoulder, 2. distinct coiled backswing with bat raised BEHIND his head, 3. attack, wide sweeping follow-through with the long bat extended HORIZONTALLY to screen RIGHT at chest height, 4. low finishing swing at waist height, slightly twisted hips, toes still grounded. Row 4 is exactly the same red-headband Cap Dollar holding a compact dark grey sci-fi arcade rifle (reference #3 for the weapon shape): 1. rest rifle cradled across chest, 2. raise into aim, 3. shouldered level rifle pointed RIGHT with small amber muzzle flash, 4. recoil. Each figure stays normal full standing height and physically contiguous. Compact chunky lively original hand-pixelled arcade sprites, hard pixel clusters, dark outlines, warm highlights, shading matching reference, clear hand grips. Generous transparent spacing within and between each cell; keep the ends of bats fully visible and SEPARATE from neighbours. No written words, titles, dividers or ground shadows.

Production inventory and fighter sprite sheet for a pixel-art arcade game, on genuine transparent background. Use the first red-headband fighter in the reference as the exact character design, and the third one's compact rifle as the rifle design. Two rows, FOUR equal cells in each row, clean generous empty gutters, without labels or shadows. TOP ROW: four separate horizontal side-view collectible objects floating alone, facing RIGHT, no hands or characters: (1) warm varnished wooden baseball bat black taped handle at left, (2) brushed silver baseball bat dark grip at left, (3) compact military-grey arcade assault rifle with shoulder stock on the left, magazine and short barrel pointing right, (4) a visibly small grey arcade pistol with short barrel on the right and dark grip. BOTTOM ROW: FOUR full-body poses of the SAME compact brown-haired fighter wearing a red headband, olive fatigues, dark gloves, brown boots. Always facing right, same footing and same proportions as reference. In every pose he holds ONLY a small dark grey semiautomatic PISTOL. 1: relaxed, pistol lowered; 2: aim to the right with one arm extended; 3: fire to right with a small gold muzzle flash; 4: pistol kicks upward in recoil. Thick dark pixel outlines, clean chunky hand-shaded pixel clusters, warm directional light, consistent retro game style. Full feet and full barrels within cells, no visual overlap, no letters, no extra objects.
